stages.prompt: We're building a help center. Please set up HelpArticle records with slug, title and body as text. Slugs must be unique. Our articles are in English; people should be able to find relevant articles by words in the title or body, ranked with BM25. Set up the schema and search indexes; we'll connect the search UI later.

params.name: schema
params.sdl: type HelpArticle { slug: String @index(ordered: {unique:true}) title: String @fulltext(language:"english") body: String @fulltext(language:"english") }
